section_summary.extract_value: This paper reports a single study examining the factor structure and psychometric properties of the Dutch BAS-2 in Dutch-speaking female undergraduates in the Netherlands, finding a one-dimensional structure and acceptable internal consistency. BAS-2 scores were significantly negatively correlated with BMI and associated with greater appearance and functionality satisfaction and well-being; limitations include the exclusively female undergraduate Netherlands sample and fixed order of measures. There is no explicit mention of 'Study 1', 'Experiment 2', or multiple sample subsets in this section.
section_summary.evidence_source: This study aimed to examine the factor structure and psychometric properties of the BAS-2 in Dutch-speaking women in the Netherlands. Exploratory factor analysis revealed a onedimensional factor structure of the Dutch BAS-2 ... In line with BAS-2 research ... scores on the Dutch BAS-2 were significantly negatively correlated with BMI. One key limitation of this study is that we only recruited Dutch-speaking female undergraduates.
